book.name: 2 Qorontoosa Kiita
book.title: Phawuloosi Qorontoosa Asaas Xaafida Nam7antho Kiita

content: Nuuni Xoossara issife oothiya asi gideysada, hinte ekida aadho keehatetha hada oothonna mela nu hintena woossoos.

content.text: atotetha gallasan nena maaddas” yaagees. Heko, ta si7iya wodey ha77i; atotetha gallasay hachi.

content: Oonika nu oosuwa borana melanne nunan dhubetana mela koyoko.
Gidoshin, nu tuma Xoossaa oosanchota gideysa nu oothiya ubbaban bessida. Daro gencan, waayen, meton, un7an,
garaafetethan, qashon, ixon kumida wocaman, daaburan, dhisko dhayon, xooman,
geeshshatethan, eratethan, danda7an, keehatethan, Geeshsha Ayyaanan, tuma siiqon,
tumaa odaninne Xoossaa wolqan nuuni iya oosanchota gideysa bessida. Qassi xillotethay nuus tooranne gondalle.
Nuuni bonchetidanne tooshetida; cayetidanne galatetida. Tumaa haasayoos, shin asay nuna wordancho gidoosona.
Nu asan eretida asi, shin eretonna asa mela gidida. Hayqidosona yaagetida, shin paxa de7oos; shocetida, shin hayqibooko.
Nuuni azzanikoka ubba wode ufaytoos. Nu manqo daanos, shin daro asaa dureyoos. Qassi aykoyka bayna asi daanos, shin ubbay nubaa.
Qorontoosa asato, nu hintew qoncen odida; nu uluwa hintena bessida.
Hinte nuna hinte siiquwa bessonna diggidetape attishin, nuuni nu siiquwa hintena diggibooko.
Aawu ba naytas odeysada ta hintew odayis; nu hintena nu uluwa bessidaysada, hinteka hinte uluwa nuna bessite.
Ammanonna asaara bessonna ogen waaxettofite. Xillotethasinne nagaras aybi gahetethi de7ii? Poo7osinne dhumas aybi issifetethi de7ii?
Kiristoosanne Xalahe issife gathiyabay aybee? Qassi ammaneysinne ammanonaysi issife koxiyabay aybee?
Xoossaa Keethas eeqatara aybi issifetethi de7ii? Xoossay,

content.text: hinte taw adde naytanne macca nayta gidana;
